apps.summary:
The world has turned to ash, dominated by zombies. Z Route—it is your final path to redemption, and the last battleground of the apocalypse. With nowhere to hide, you can only advance, weapon ready! Redemption or doom? The choice is in your hands!​​
​Crash through every gate of choice and tear through the horde amid roaring engines. Only speed and ruthlessness will keep you alive. Are you ready? This is your war.

In an apocalypse, no one survives alone. Recruit warriors with different specialties and build the ultimate squad. Strategy and teamwork are your only path to survival.

Every gate is a gamble between life and death. Choose right, and you'll find supplies. Choose wrong, and face the horde. Time is short, so you must decide fast. ​Only the smartest and toughest will achieve redemption!​​
​- Arm Yourself​
The stronger your weapon, the better your chances. But fate is fickle; survival also depends on luck.
​- Speedrun Stages​
Speed is your shield. Dash, dodge, counter—don't stop! Only by pushing forward can you keep death at bay.
​- Conquer Powerful Enemies​
You never know what monsters await you at the end of the road. The only thing you can do is to keep arming yourself and be ready for anything!

Download Z Route: Redemption now!​​ Gear up and make your stand. Danger lurks everywhere on the highway of death. Your battle has already begun. Never back down. Survival favors the bold!

apps.title: Vice Throne
apps.summary:
**Important Notice**: Direct over‑installation of the new client version may result in installation failure. Please uninstall the old version on your device first, then install the new version. We will optimize and fix this issue as soon as possible.

This city looks prosperous on the surface, with skyscrapers rising high and traffic flowing nonstop. But when night falls, turf wars and power struggles quietly begin, and every gang starts eyeing the highest seat of power in this land.

I have returned with vengeance burning in my heart and the resolve to rise again.

In the ruined Manor, the chair where the old Godfather once sat has been empty for far too long. Now, at last, its true heir has returned.

[Take Back Everything. Start by Rebuilding Your Base]

Leave the house neglected for too long, and the "rats" come crawling in. They gnaw away at the legacy the old Godfather left behind, treating the family's turf like their own pantry.

Drive out the enemy forces occupying the manor and city blocks, restore order to the family business, for only then can we plan for the long game. The city blocks, docks, and businesses they stole from us... I will take them all back, one by one.

[Easy Money. Collect "Windfall Cash" with One Tap]

A shortage of funds and supplies is the biggest obstacle on the road to rebuilding, and our trade network must be urgently restored.

Fortunately, we still control several thriving businesses across the city. Patrol these areas, and you will often find a few "unexpected gains." Some money practically collects itself.

[Recruit Capable Captains and Build Your Inner Circle]

The old Godfather left behind a loyal group of trusted hands. While I was lying low, they fought hard to hold the family business together. But they alone are not enough.

Use strategy and influence to recruit talented people from every corner, then train them carefully and sharpen their skills. Knowing how to recognize talent and putting the right people in the right positions is a lesson every true leader must master.

[Train Your Soldiers and Rule the Streets]

Loyalty is the family's creed. Power is the most effective passport in the underworld.

I will purge every traitor, train elite soldiers who answer only to me, and lead them into the fiercest assaults. Every battle will teach these scum trying to stop me one thing: making an enemy of me never ends well.

[Global Alliances. Find Allies Who Fight Beside You]

"There are no permanent friends, only shared interests." When our goals align, forming alliances with other active powers in this city is simple.

Send out your intent to ally, and responses will come from all over the world. Rally together, share resources, exchange intel. For now, we stand side by side as allies.

[Meet Beautiful Companions and Cherish Every True Heart]

If luck is on my side, I just might cross paths with some very "special" companions. They don't care about my status or power. They only want to stay by my side.

When they send messages, ask for dates, or invite me into something more intimate, I cannot betray their feelings. A true powerhouse can hold the throne and still win a heart.

[Conquer the World and Claim the Highest Throne]

The empire I want to build will not stop at this city. Every Base, every port, every city is on my list to conquer.

Crush them from the outskirts inward. Wipe out the enemy, seize their turf, join forces with the strong, and strike straight at the center of the world. The one true throne is waiting there.

Vice Throne is a free-to-play game. Some in-game items (including random items) can be purchased.

Download the game now, begin your rise to power and unlock even more awesome content!

apps.title: Halloween Jigcard-Puzzle Game
apps.summary:
Halloween Jigcard Puzzle – Spooky Jigsaw Card Fun!
Get ready for a spooky puzzle adventure!
Halloween Jigcard Puzzle combines the relaxing satisfaction of jigsaw puzzles with a fresh card-moving experience. Slide, match, connect, and snap puzzle cards together to reveal charming Halloween pictures filled with pumpkins, ghosts, witches, black cats, haunted houses, and more.
Every puzzle starts with scattered picture cards. Look carefully, find the matching connections, and bring the image back to life piece by piece. When the right cards snap together, enjoy that satisfying feeling of watching your Halloween picture take shape!
Whether you love jigsaw puzzles, card puzzles, or simply want a relaxing way to enjoy the Halloween season, Halloween Jigcard Puzzle offers an easy-to-learn and delightfully spooky experience.
🎃 HOW TO PLAY
- Slide the Cards
Move puzzle cards freely across the board with simple swipe controls.
- Find the Connections
Look closely at each image and discover which cards belong together.
- Match & Snap
Place matching cards next to each other and watch them snap perfectly into place.
- Build Bigger Pieces
Connected cards stay together, letting you move entire sections of the picture at once.
- Complete the Picture
Keep matching until every card comes together and the full Halloween image is revealed!
👻 GAME FEATURES
🎃 A Halloween Puzzle Adventure
Explore a collection of spooky and cozy Halloween pictures featuring glowing pumpkins, mysterious castles, friendly ghosts, witches, black cats, autumn nights, and much more.
🧩 Jigsaw Puzzle Meets Card Puzzle
Enjoy a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles. Instead of traditional puzzle pieces, move and connect picture cards to complete each scene.
✨ Satisfying Snap Moments
There is nothing better than finding the perfect match. Watch cards lock together and enjoy satisfying chain reactions as multiple pieces connect.
👉 Simple Swipe Controls
Just swipe, move, and match. The intuitive controls make it easy to start playing anytime.
🧠 Relaxing Yet Engaging
Take your time, observe the pictures, and find the right connections. No complicated rules—just relaxing puzzle-solving fun with a little Halloween mystery.
🌙 Spooky, Cozy & Beautiful Artwork
Discover atmospheric Halloween scenes ranging from cute and colorful to mysterious and magical.
🏆 Puzzles for Everyone
Easy to learn and satisfying to master, whether you're a casual puzzle player or a jigsaw fan looking for something different.
🕯️ ENTER THE HALLOWEEN WORLD
A jack-o'-lantern glowing in the night.
A black cat watching from the window.
A mysterious haunted house beneath the moon.
What picture is hiding inside the cards?
Slide the pieces, discover the connections, and reveal them all.
Download Halloween Jigcard Puzzle and start your spooky puzzle journey today!

apps.title: Idle MMA: Octagon Champion
apps.summary:
Build the next undisputed champion in an idle MMA fighting game with automatic cage battles. Watch your fighter punch, kick, wrestle, grapple, score knockouts, and hunt for submissions while you choose upgrades and guide an underdog from gritty garage fights to the world championship

Automatic MMA Fighting
No complicated combos, frantic tapping, or difficult controls. Your MMA fighter enters the cage and battles rival after rival automatically. You decide how to develop the champion; the fighter handles the action. Watch punches, kicks, takedowns, grappling, knockouts, and submissions unfold in fast mixed martial arts battles.

From Garage Brawls to World Championships
Begin your fighting career at the bottom in a dusty garage and a dark underground basement. Defeat local opponents, enter regional circuits, rise through national promotions, and earn a place in packed professional arenas. New venues and tougher contenders make every step toward the championship belt feel bigger.

Build Your Own Martial Arts Style
Spend battle rewards on power, speed, health, defense, stamina, and technique. Create a lightning-fast boxer, a heavy-handed kickboxer, a relentless wrestler, a dangerous Muay Thai striker, or a BJJ submission specialist. Combine martial arts skills and stat upgrades to build the MMA fighter you want.

Idle Progress That Never Stops
Earn rewards through continuous automatic fights and return to collect offline earnings. Upgrade your fighter, break through the next career tier, and prepare for stronger opponents. This idle MMA game is easy to play in short sessions but always gives you another stat, skill, rival, or arena to chase.

Act as Trainer and Fight Manager
You are more than a spectator. Choose the right attributes, develop a winning fighting style, and turn every reward into more power. Build a fast striker, a durable heavyweight tank, or a grappling specialist capable of ending fights by submission.

Game Features
• Idle MMA fighting with automatic cage battles
• A complete fighter career from underground fights to world championships
• Boxing, kickboxing, wrestling, Muay Thai, and BJJ-inspired upgrades
• Punches, kicks, takedowns, grappling, knockouts, and submissions
• Strategic stat allocation and fighter evolution
• New rivals, promotion tiers, venues, rewards, and championship belts
• Offline idle rewards for continued progress
• Leaderboard competition and an undefeated career streak

If you enjoy MMA games, idle fighting games, martial arts games, boxing, wrestling, combat sports, and career progression RPGs, step into the cage and start your rise.

Train your fighter. Win automatic fights. Claim the belt. Build an MMA legend.

apps.title: Bendy's Nightmare Run
apps.summary:
Bendy's Nightmare Run is back!

Run as Bendy, Boris, or Alice in a nightmare-fueled endless runner where the goal is simple: survive the chase and defeat crazy cartoon bosses.

RUN FROM TROUBLE

Dash through four themed episodes filled with enemies, obstacles, collectibles, weapons, and powerups. Swipe left and right to move, swipe up to jump or double jump, and swipe down to slam onto enemies as you race away from increasingly difficult bosses.

Collect Bacon Soup and XP as you run, and use your rewards to unlock characters, levels, weapons, costumes, and powerful upgrades.

DEFEAT THE BOSSES

Every level puts you in a chase against a unique cartoon boss. Collect weapons during your run to throw them back at that big, bad bully. Dodge attacks, manage your health, use powerups, and defeat the boss before it defeats you.

FOUR NIGHTMARISH EPISODES

Explore four original environments, each with its own boss:

• Bendy in Treasure Trouble — Dash across sandy islands, wooden docks, and pirate ships while Chester the treasure chest chases you through the tropics.

Last Isle: Survival is a multiplayer online survival game combining island building, FPS combat, and extraction gameplay. A global flood has submerged 99% of the land, leaving humanity scattered across isolated islands. Trade items freely and turn loot into profit.

apps.summary:
"The anthem of humanity is the hymn of bravery!"

The officially-licensed mobile game for the hit anime series Jojo's Bizarre Adventure! A faithful recreation of the original world from this multigenerational RPG — JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Spirit is finally here! Take on the "golden spirit" of the Joestar bloodline and set out on a bizarre adventure of your own today!

▶ 3D Modeling + Live2D: Relive Iconic Moments
This is more than just a game: It's an entirely immersive experience for anime addicts! High-precision 3D models and Live2D are utilized to recreate iconic moments from the anime, frame by frame. Not only is the soundtrack composed by Yugo Kanno — mastermind behind both "Stardust Crusaders" and "The JoJoLands" OSTs — the 360° free camera view and cinematography turn every fight into a scintillating visual feast!

▶ Assemble an Ensemble of Jojos & Fight Alongside Their Stands
From "Phantom Blood" to "Stone Ocean," all the colorful characters from 6 generations of Jojos are here! Master your Stands and abilities to carefully command your characters to victory! Trigger iconic scenes from the original series as you activate your Stand abilities for finishing moves. Team up with characters from different series to weave an all-new bizarre adventure with the characters you love!

▶ Strategize With Rush & Turn the Tide of Combat
Just standing there and fighting is out, grandpa! Optimize each character's different attack range to configure combat and seize your chance to counterattack with a Rush. This game is stacked with all kinds of strategic elements, which is the key to recreating the anime's sense of psychological warfare. Push the envelope and seize victory — let strategy be your ultimate weapon!

▶ 360° Free Camera View & Real-Time Weather System
Immerse yourself in dynamic real-time combat with freely switchable camera angles. Enjoy a 360° view that captures the intensity of each blow. The volatile real-time weather system influences character abilities and combat dynamics, introducing unexpected twists to every battle!

▶ Build Your Dream Team With Multi-Faceted Progression Systems
Cultivate your characters through Stand awakening, skill enhancement, gear forging, and character ascension. Dive deep into a diverse cultivation system that offers unparalleled strategic flexibility. Discover the perfect synergy and build a dream team capable of crushing any foe!

▶ Relive the Original with Diverse Challenge Modes, World Bosses, and PvP
Multiple different challenge modes await: stages that immerse you in the original anime story; World Boss battles featuring powerful enemies from the anime; and even a ranked PvP mode for psychological warfare against players around the globe — prove that you are the true champion of this bizarre adventure!

Choose your player position — winger, center, defenseman, or goalie.

apps.title: Transport Tycoon Empire 2

Build your transport empire and shape history.

Welcome to Transport Tycoon Empire 2, a rich and immersive transport tycoon game where you take on the role of a transport manager. Start with a struggling logistics company in 1930s America and rise to become a global leader in transportation.

Take control of trains, ships, planes, and trucks as you create efficient transport lines between cities, mines, factories, and ports. Deliver passengers and a wide variety of cargo, upgrade your fleet, and optimize every route for speed and profit. Prove yourself as a skilled logistics manager on your journey from humble beginnings to industrial dominance.

📦 Think Like a Logistics manager
Design complex transport networks, connect supply chains, and balance production and demand. Every decision you make as a manager will shape the economy of entire regions.

🚂 Trains, Planes, Ships & Trucks
Manage four classes of vehicles: rail, air, water, and road—each with unique stats and upgrade paths. As a fleet manager, you’ll need to optimize for distance, capacity, and cargo type.

🌍 Historic Eras & Real-World Challenges
Advance through decades, from the Great Depression to the Cold War and beyond. Each era introduces new technologies, events, and gameplay twists. Face fuel shortages, wars, and environmental crises as you expand your empire.

🏙️ Main City Growth
Develop your main city—the heart of your empire. Upgrading it unlocks new routes, boosts production, and generates more passengers.

🔧 Upgradeable Everything
Enhance vehicles, stations, factories, and more. Tailor your strategy to meet changing demands and unlock rare contracts.

🌐 Cross-Regional Progression
Complete contracts, earn XP, and unlock new regions. Each region offers new biomes, challenges, and a fresh start to test your skills again.

🎯 Perfect for Fans of Strategy & Simulation
Transport Tycoon Empire 2 combines deep systems design with accessible gameplay. Whether you’re a transport enthusiast, strategy lover, or aspiring transport manager, you’ll find endless satisfaction in optimizing your routes and growing your empire.

For support, please contact us at [support@aldagames.com]

apps.title: Bola Capture
apps.summary:
Draw a line. Fling the bola. Watch it wrap.

Bola Capture is a physics playground built around one irresistible move: throwing
a weighted cord and watching it coil around whatever it touches. Your targets
stagger and flail on fully simulated ragdoll bodies — and one well-aimed throw
turns that wobbling mess into a neatly bound bundle.

■ ONE SIMPLE MOVE
Drag anywhere on the screen to draw your throw.
- The direction you draw is the direction the cord spins.
- The longer the line, the longer the rope.
- Let go, and the bola whips away, spinning and trailing, in cinematic slow motion.
Long strokes reach farther and sweep up more targets at once. Short ones snap in
fast and close. Keep up to three bolas in the air at the same time.

■ CHAOS, THEN COLLAPSE
Nothing here is a canned animation. Every stumble, tangle and tumble falls out of
live physics.
- Wrap a single leg and they lose their footing all on their own.
- Catch a whole crowd in one throw and cinch them into a single struggling bundle.
- Rope them to lampposts, girders and steel trusses to pin them down for good.
- Sunglasses pop off. Eyes go wide. They squirm, they glare right back at you.
- Whatever they were carrying slips out of their hands and clatters to the floor.
Because it all runs on real simulation, the same throw never plays out twice.

■ TEN SHORT STAGES, BUILT BY HAND
Among them:
- A skyscraper rooftop, high above the city
- An office floor, desks and all
- A boxing ring wrapped in a giant steel truss
- A street chase between a cop and a thief
- Trash cans that burst open, lids and litter flying

■ MADE FOR ONE HAND
Portrait. One thumb. No timers, no game over, no pressure — if a throw misses,
just throw again. Stages are short enough for a spare minute on the train, and
the chaos keeps rolling as long as you feel like playing.

Grab the cord and start wrapping.
How much can you catch in a single throw?

apps.title: AI Dungeon Master & RPG Fablia
apps.summary:
Fablia is an AI Dungeon Master that runs a fantasy RPG built around you. No group to schedule, no rulebook to memorise, no waiting for anyone else. Describe what your hero does, and the AI narrates what happens next.

A DUNGEON MASTER THAT NEVER RUNS OUT OF STORY
Type any action and the AI Dungeon Master answers it. Talk your way past the gate guards, torch the tavern, spare the bandit who begged, or walk away from the whole quest. The story bends around your choice and remembers what you did. No two runs tell the same tale, because nothing is scripted.

THREE WAYS TO BEGIN YOUR QUEST
• Quick Start — drop into an adventure in seconds
• Forge — a guided RPG character creator. Choose your age and origin, take the skills your past earned you, then spend your stat points
• Sandbox — no rules, no rails. Write your own world, set its laws, seed the people who matter, and tell the Dungeon Master exactly how to run it

ROLL THE DICE AND LIVE WITH IT
Skill checks are settled the tabletop way, with a real D20 roll rendered in 3D with sound and haptics. Beat the target and you stay on your feet. Miss it and fortune turns against you. Push your luck too far and you are rolling a death save.

YOUR HERO, YOUR RECORD
• Character sheet tracking stats, skills and gear
• Codex that fills in with the lore, people and places you uncover
• Chronicle of every scene in your campaign
• Multiple save slots, so several adventures can run side by side

BE ANYONE, WITH NO LIMITS
Play the knight who keeps their oath or the one who breaks it. Be a scheming merchant, a hedge witch, a deserter, a god-touched fool. The AI roleplay adapts to the character you actually write, not a class you picked from a list.

WHY PLAYERS PICK FABLIA
• A solo RPG you can play in five minutes or five hours
• Interactive fiction with real consequences, not a branching menu
• A text adventure where you type freely instead of tapping preset replies
• A choose your own adventure engine that never repeats itself
• Tabletop-style dungeon crawling without needing a party

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Explore ruined keeps and drowned shrines. Bargain, bluff and threaten your way through encounters. Recruit companions and lose them. Build a hero from nothing and watch the world start reacting to your name. Or throw all of it out and build a world of your own in Sandbox, down to how the Dungeon Master should narrate it.

Fablia is for anyone who loves fantasy RPG storytelling, interactive story games, AI roleplay, dungeon master simulators, text adventures and classic tabletop roleplaying, but wants it available the moment the mood strikes.

Your world is unwritten. Begin your quest.

Crossword meets Hexa!

Words of Wonders Hexa (WoW Hexa) is a brand-new word puzzle from the creators of Words of Wonders, where you solve crosswords by swiping through connected hexagon tiles. It's not just what you spell — it's how you get there.

Every level gives you a honeycomb of letters. Trace a path through adjacent hexagons to form words, and each correct word snaps into the crossword above. One board, two brains: your vocabulary finds the word, your eyes find the path.

Why WoW Hexa feels different
Classic word games give you a wheel of letters — WoW Hexa gives you a hexagon board where only touching tiles connect. The same letters can hide many paths, and only the right ones spell the words you need.

Endless variety of boards
From compact honeycombs to sprawling hexagon grids, every chapter reshapes the board and resets the challenge. No two levels play the same.

Bonus words and rewards
Sharp eyes earn extra: discover hidden bonus words for coins, and use hints when a tricky crossword has you stuck.

Relax while you play
Serene landscapes, gentle animations, and no time pressure make WoW Hexa the perfect game to calm your mind while keeping it sharp.

apps.title: Narco Empire
apps.summary:
Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

apps.title: Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort
apps.summary:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

apps.title: Eileen Saga: The Crush Girl
apps.summary:
The rift between time and space connecting different worlds appears quietly, and travelers from the other side walk through the light gate and step into this strange land to conclude a contract with you. They have the power of ancient inheritance, but they are full of curiosity about the different world in front of them.
And you became their first guide here.

[Alien visitors conclude a contract with you]
There are more than 100 characters from different worlds waiting to meet you in the game.
Their identities are different: swordsmen from famous families, scholars who study the mysteries of elements, divine officials with missions, and assassins hiding in the shadows. Everyone has their own vertical drawing design and skill system.
Through checkpoints, activities and recruitment, you can invite them to join the team and become partners in fighting side by side.

[Round-to-Round Battle, Line-up Match]
You need to reasonably arrange the position and order of the characters according to the characteristics of the enemy. Front row injury bearing, rear row output, treatment endurance, field control interference-different functions do their own jobs, in order to defeat the enemy.
There is the possibility of linking skills, and the combination of some roles can trigger additional effects. How to match the lineup is a subject that you need to continue to study.

[Role cultivation, steady improvement of combat power]
Each partner can grow gradually through fighting and resource investment.
Upgrade basic attributes, break through the upper limit of unlocking a higher level, strengthen skills and enhance the power of moves, and equipment replacement will bring intuitive combat power bonus.
The cultivation path is clear, and the pace of resource delivery is stable. There is no need to chase blindly. If you advance a little every day, the team will grow stronger.

[Competitive learning, competing with other summoners]
The arena is the best place to test the strength of the lineup.
Match opponents with similar strength and automatically fight to decide the outcome. Your role training, lineup and tactical layout will be objectively tested in the game.
Accumulate the winning games, upgrade the position, and award the season settlement. The top players can get exclusive honor marks, and ordinary players also have stable resources to account for.

[Main adventure, step by step to uncover the truth of the world]
The main line of the game is promoted in the form of chapters, and each chapter contains several battle levels.
From the initial area around the crack to the hinterland of another world, we met all kinds of enemies and allies along the way. The difficulty of the level is step by step. Come and start your brainstorming!

[Daily welfare, the sense of companionship with a long stream of water]
Log in every day to get a gift, and sign in to get extra gifts.
Complete daily tasks to accumulate activity and enrich activities to produce rare props.
This is a game that respects your time. You can enjoy yourself if you want to study hard, and you can enjoy yourself if you want to collect easily.

The crack has opened, and the wind from another world is blowing towards this continent.
Your contract, from this moment on.

apps.title: Evolution Arena Heroes
apps.summary:
Transform into a young mage and venture into an ancient castle to fight dragons!
There are two battle modes: Classic and Adventure. Spend keys to start dragon boss fights.
Use the directional pad to move nimbly, dodge dragon fire projectiles and cast fire spells to strike back.
Keep bombs and HP potions in your bag to clear all shots and restore health in emergencies.
Complete battle quests to earn coins, then buy keys and supplies from the item shop.
Unlock fun challenges like fast clear runs and winning streaks, enjoy relaxing shooting battles!

🎧 Feel the rhythm and hit the drums of the matching color.

🎧 Wearing headphones is recommended for a more perfect drumming experience 💝

👍 Super easy to pick up (even beginners can get started easily)!
